about: Gap tool drags measured in InDesign 2025 (20.5.5.119) with REAL mouse and key input (docinput-c3: 8 cases; gaptool-c1: the rest; tools artifacts/gaptool-c1-20261023/tools, logs out/). The gap goes by the pointer's way rounded to 0.75 pt steps (the screen's business, ui/dragunit.ts), so `expected` is compared with the tolerance. `rect` = [left, top, right, bottom] in page points; `page` = the page [width, height] the case was measured on (absent: the fixture's own A4 page; the frames then sit 300 pt lower than measured); `nearest` is Shift; `rot` turns a frame about its centre; `hidden`; `group` = indexes of the frames put in one group. Ctrl, Alt and Ctrl+Alt gave the plain result (`mods_*_same_as_plain`).
